name: Asher Dale
headline: Founding Engineer @ Omnara
description: Asher is a founding engineer at Omnara, a YC-backed startup building an open-source platform for running and managing AI agents in production. He's an active open-source contributor and built side projects like 'Rate My Homepage,' which scores websites using AI agents running on Omnara. He's part of the team hosting this hackathon.

name: Christian Sparks
headline: Engineer (Agents) @ Omnara
description: Christian works on agents at Omnara. He was previously a systems engineer at Cloudflare, where he built the customer-facing CI/build systems for Workers and Pages, and has given conference talks on deploying full-stack React apps on Cloudflare. UIUC grad, based in San Francisco.

name: Yonas Tsegai
headline: MS Computer Science Student @ San Francisco Bay University
description: Yonas is a master's student in computer science at San Francisco Bay University and an aspiring software engineer. He focuses on Python backend development (FastAPI, REST APIs, PostgreSQL) and is actively exploring LLM integration and AI agents.

name: Leandro Vallejos
headline: Founder & CEO @ Pearl Tech Inc.
description: Leandro is the founder and CEO of Pearl Tech Inc., where he builds personalized autonomous systems and brains for robots. His past work includes an AI-driven investment engine using statistical and AI models and a previous AI dating app venture where he led product, engineering, and fundraising.

name: Vincent Leguide
headline: INFODIP (Edge AI systems)
description: Vincent is affiliated with INFODIP, a French OEM computer-systems partner that designs and integrates custom appliances and Edge AI deployment solutions (partners include Supermicro, NVIDIA, Dell, and Intel). He is listed as a judge for the 2026 Globee Awards for Innovation representing INFODIP.

name: Chintan Gandhi
headline: Senior Product Manager @ Zoca AI
description: Chintan is a Senior Product Manager at Zoca AI, building voice and marketing agents for US small businesses in the beauty and wellness space. He has 3+ years of product experience on products used by 10M+ users, previously as a PM at Relevel by Unacademy and founding PM at Investmint.
luma_bio: Senior Product Manager at Zoca AI. Building voice and marketing agents for SMBs in the US in beauty and wellness space.

name: Malla Reddy
headline: Nexurova
description: MallaReddy is an IT professional with more than two decades of experience in software product development, currently at Nexurova. He is based in Morgan Hill, California.

name: George Wee
headline: Backend Software Engineer @ Wells Fargo
description: George is a backend software engineer at Wells Fargo in San Francisco, building commercial banking services with Java.

name: Pavan Adipuram
headline: Founder & CEO @ Nexurova
description: Founder and CEO of Nexurova, a Milpitas, CA company building blockchain and GenAI products for businesses and government; its product T-Chits has run for the Government of Telangana, India since 2018. Previously Founding Partner/CEO of The Pangean Group and ex-TCS, with 22+ years as a builder, operator and founder; Forbes contributor.
luma_bio: Founder @ Nexurova — building AI-driven fintech products. Ex-TCS. Forbes contributor. 22+ years as Builder, Operator & Founder with a "Y"

name: Stefano Stokes
headline: Founder & CEO @ Forhemit
description: San Francisco-based founder and CEO of Forhemit, which helps founder-led businesses transition to 100% employee ownership through ESOP structuring, and has also described Forhemit as building digital AI employee solutions. His background spans planning, policy, and finance, including disaster planning and policy work for the City of San Francisco.

name: David Tabachnik
headline: Product Manager @ Google
description: Product manager based in San Francisco, currently at Google, with earlier work at Amazon in industrial real estate and capital planning. Runs a side project, dishcover.io, a service for searching dishes and finding restaurants that serve them.

name: Venkata Aduri
headline: Stealth AI Startup
description: Computer science professional currently working at a stealth AI startup. He pursued a Master's degree at the University of North Carolina at Charlotte and is now US-based.

name: Trevor Kang
description: San Francisco-based builder exploring startup ideas in e-commerce and AI automation. He maintains a personal site at trevkang.com.

name: Timothy Altman
headline: Big Data Platform Engineer @ LinkedIn
description: Big Data Platform Engineer at LinkedIn. He graduated from Mississippi State University with a degree in Computer Science and Engineering.

name: Prem Babu Kanaparthi
headline: AI/ML Engineer | MS in AI @ RIT
description: Prem is an AI/ML engineer focused on LLM inference, agent infrastructure, retrieval, evaluation, and applied ML, pursuing an MS in Artificial Intelligence at Rochester Institute of Technology. He previously worked as a Generative AI Engineer at Concentrix, where he built a production multi-model LLM routing layer using LiteLLM with AWS Bedrock and SageMaker.

name: Sri Varshini
headline: Machine Learning Engineer @ Novacis Digital
description: Sri Varshini is a Machine Learning Engineer at Novacis Digital LLC. She studied at Rochester Institute of Technology.

name: Karam G
headline: Forward Deployed Engineer @ Checksum AI
description: Karam is a San Francisco-based AI engineer at Checksum AI, where he owns an agent that generates and self-heals end-to-end Playwright tests for enterprise clients. MS in CS from UC Davis; previously at Hyperlink and FIS. He optimizes models to run on consumer hardware, and his side projects include a Rust/Tauri IDE for running multiple AI agents and real-time PII redaction for video.
luma_bio: I optimize models to run on consumer hardware.

name: Aneesh Dharani
headline: Co-founder & CEO @ Learvo
description: Aneesh is the co-founder and CEO of Learvo, a San Francisco-based free AI study tool that turns college students' uploaded materials into quizzes, flashcards, summaries, and mnemonics, answering only from uploaded sources with citations. UIUC alum with a background in tech sales and product before going all-in on the startup.

name: Nikhil Kulkarni
headline: AI / MLOps Engineer (ex-Google via TCS)
description: Nikhil is a Mountain View-based AI engineer focused on inference infrastructure and agent-native tools. He is building Iridium, an MCP server that connects Claude/ChatGPT to LinkedIn so agents can read profiles and draft engagement content, and has merged open-source contributions to vLLM, SGLang, and Ax. Previously a frontend engineer at Google via TCS; Rutgers CS grad.

name: Ilia Prikhodko
headline: Student @ University of Washington
description: Ilia is a Seattle-based student at the University of Washington who describes himself as an aspiring founder of an AI + brain-computer interface (BCI) startup.

name: Julia Amancio Ghioto
headline: Student @ Minerva University
description: Julia is a Brazilian undergraduate student at Minerva University, the globally rotating university headquartered in San Francisco.

name: Noah Boesen
headline: Founding Engineer @ Parahelp
description: Noah is a Danish engineer who has been a Founding Engineer at Parahelp, the AI customer-support agent startup, since January 2025. He previously worked as an AI Engineer at Share Ventures, as a Generative AI Engineer at Gastroto, and co-founded Skolegang.dk.

name: João Paulo Dias Geller
headline: Student @ Minerva University
description: João is a Brazilian student from Porto Alegre in Minerva University's Class of 2030, planning to major in Computational Sciences and Applied Mathematics.
luma_bio:
Minerva University Class of 2030
Brazilian Student from Porto Alegre
Planning to major in Computational sciences and Applied Mathematics

name: Shesha Sai Kumar Reddy Sadu
headline: Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist
description: Machine learning engineer and data scientist who recently completed an MS in Data Science at the University of Minnesota. Previously worked as a data scientist at Tata Consultancy Services and interned at OpenText.

name: Viktor Číhal
headline: Founder @ Telarchy
description: Czech developer and entrepreneur (CS degree from Charles University) building Telarchy, a decision-forecasting platform that predicts how a decision affects your metrics before you commit, with prediction-market trading open to both humans and AI agents. Previously built LookPilot, webcam-based head/eye tracking software with roughly 10,000 paying customers. Currently in San Francisco seeking cofounders, customers, and investors.

name: Jeneece Izmaganbet
headline: Founder @ Zentron
description: B2B-tech founder working at the intersection of compliance, fintech, and AI. Building Zentron, a platform that automates the quarterly financial close for captive insurance managers, and is hiring a founding AI engineer. Previously associated with Veturi, a B2B AI venture studio, and co-founded Victara.ai.
luma_bio: Zentron - captive insurance ops. Hiring a founding AI engineer

name: Livia G
headline: BioRender
description: Livia works at BioRender, the science-figure creation platform, and studied at the University of Toronto. Her background blends product management and biomedical research, with certifications in AI Product Management.

name: Sidra Miconi
headline: Founder @ AgentGlass
description: San Francisco Bay Area AI engineer and founder of AgentGlass, a reliability layer and evals product for AI agents. A prolific hackathon builder: created OpsGate, a simulation-based reliability gate for enterprise AI agents that won a $10K prize, and Recover AI, an autonomous revenue-recovery agent.

name: Kyle Samuelson
headline: Founder @ SteelReel AI
description: Robotics technologist who runs SteelReel AI, an evidence-led machine media venture producing AI-native robotics video, with a database tracking 234 humanoid robots and robotics competitions. He has worked as an electro-mechanical technician at UBTECH Robotics and appeared as a robo-tech on the Robot Combat League TV show. Long-time robotics instructor and mentor.

name: Ömer Incialan
headline: Founder (AI agent platform for solopreneurs)
description: Turkish-born founder, ex-venture capital analyst, and ex-IT project manager who previously built a fast-growing DTC furniture business. Now building an AI-agent platform to help solopreneurs handle inbound CRM, while pursuing a statistical data science master's and conducting financial research using ML and agentic architectures.

name: Rohan Katakam
headline: Founding Team @ Serafis (YC S25)
description: Founding team member at Serafis (YC S25), a San Francisco startup building an AI knowledge graph and narrative-intelligence platform for private-market investors, indexing 100,000+ podcast and interview transcripts. Studied CS + Economics at UIUC and previously worked as an SWE II at Oracle.

name: Rohit Katakam
headline: CS Student @ Northwestern / Commure
description: Final-year computer science student at Northwestern University who works at Commure, the healthcare technology company. Likely related to fellow attendee Rohan Katakam.

name: Saish Shinde
headline: Founding Engineer @ Muro.ai (probable)
description: Bay Area software developer; likely a founding engineer at Muro.ai in Sunnyvale and San José State University grad with MERN-stack experience. An active SF hackathon participant who built 'Scripted,' a hands-free video intelligence platform, at the Google I/O Hackathon.
